label: Overlapping events
hint: Hover across the overlap to reveal each appointment.

steps.caption: Move away to close appointment details

paragraphs: A full calendar can contain several overlapping events. To keep each accessible, cards shrink to fit their lanes and expand on hover for a quick glance.

An expanded card can cover others underneath. I treat those as “underlying” events: the pointer reveals the event whose original card occupies that position, even when another event’s hover content covers it.
